about_the_game:
Game

Still Hope is an investigation and psychological horror game. You play as Sam, an investigator. Formally a doctor, Sam has a past he's not proud of. He investigates cases to atone for those past mistakes.

Jess Miller has been missing for a few days, and his current case is to find her. His journey becomes extremely challenging due to some uninvited guests from his past life.

Gameplay

The game lets you explore the entire research facility, travel to various locations, and figure out what happened to Jess.

The player, depending on the selected inventory, receives power-ups. For example, the master key can unlock many doors, and the stamina booster can let the player walk faster. The player always leaves some inventory behind.

Game Features

The game is narration-based, with the player connected to Tyla (his wife) online to guide him through the case. The game adds real-life features, such as heavy breathing, hallucinations, nightmares, and more.

What You'll Get

You will enjoy about 3 hours of gameplay through Sam's eyes and experience Jess's and Sam's story in this narration-based, investigation, psychological horror game.
